verdict.rationale: Apple publishes 153GB/s memory bandwidth and claims unified memory lets the M5 run 'larger AI models' and LLMs locally (e.g. in LM Studio or webAI). However, the documented memory ceiling is 32GB, which is too small for a quantized 70B-class model. Community users confirm the 32GB cap is the bigger problem and call the bandwidth insufficient for viable open LLMs, citing only ~30B MoE models as practical, so the story's 70B-class goal is not delivered on this chip.
